assumptions: Regular K>0 HR principal-root chart; Lg,Lf,N,M,K>0; six canonical coordinates fixed at boundary; N,M,V fixed; independent ambient boundary jets pLg,pLg',pSg. Does not assume full constraint tangency.
theorem: No differentiable local boundary scalar C with dC=-Theta on an open unrestricted coordinate-Dirichlet ambient boundary-jet domain containing independent pLg and pLg' variations: dTheta !=0. This is not a no-go on the full Dirac constraint tangent space.

conditional_counterterms.fixed_pLg_and_fixed_N_M_V: C=-2Mg2*N*Sg*Sg'/Lg-2Mf2*M*Sf*Sf'/Lf+V*Lf*pLf; valid only on stated restricted tangent directions
conditional_counterterms.unfixed_zstar_obstruction: delta C includes A*pLg*delta zstar; witness A*pLg*d(zstar)/d(pSg)=6/25

limits: No physically selected boundary polarization or lapse variations
No full six-pair Poisson/Dirac matrix, rank or tertiary constraints
K=0 and J=0 charts not treated
